stem.text: Which statement describes the effect of increased carbon dioxide concentration on the oxygen dissociation curve of human haemoglobin and its significance?

A.text: The curve shifts to the left allowing haemoglobin to bind more oxygen in active tissues.

B.text: The curve shifts to the left allowing haemoglobin to offload more oxygen in active tissues.

C.text: The curve shifts to the right allowing haemoglobin to bind more oxygen in active tissues.

D.text: The curve shifts to the right allowing haemoglobin to offload more oxygen in active tissues.
